user.title: Connect a limited home job
user.description: In the Genesis Mesh app, create or open your job and choose Connect to Home Assistant. Enter its single-use pairing code here. One connection runs one bounded job.

data.use_custom_address: My app uses a different installation address (advanced)

address.title: Different installation address
address.description: Use the address for your private Genesis Mesh app. Normal Home Assistant installations use the detected default.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect this job
reauth_confirm.description: Open this job in Genesis Mesh and generate a new pairing code. Its permissions and expiry still apply.

error.cannot_pair: Pairing did not complete. Check that Genesis Mesh is running, the address is correct, and the code has not expired or already been used. Generate a new code in the app if needed.

abort.already_configured: This job already has a Home Assistant connection. Use its existing connection or reconnect it.
abort.invalid_discovery: The discovered app address is invalid. Open Genesis Mesh to check its connection settings.
abort.wrong_job: That code belongs to a different job. Generate a code for this job instead.
abort.reauth_successful: The job is connected again. Its current limits and expiry apply.
